arc_summary: I'm creating a joyful childhood memory montage that builds from peaceful nostalgia to energetic celebration, then resolves into warm wholesomeness. The edit follows the musical energy curve, starting with gentle moments, building through playful chaos, peaking with pure joy, and ending with a lingering smile that perfectly frames the text overlay.
